text_block_list.text:
The day after Грасс Вандер's day off, I
head over
to my office only to find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh! I-I'm sorry. I only meant to take a
quick rest
on the sofa.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Did you get enough sleep yesterday?

text_block_list.text:
Well, I sort of lost track of time while
gazing at
my moss terrarium last night.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
There is an art to growing moss in a glass
tank,
and it brings me joy to observe its
daily progress.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: But I need to take care not to let it cut into my sleep schedule... Yawn...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It seems Грасс Вандер stayed up late
rather than
get a proper night's rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
